title: Reefing a yacht: when and how to shorten sail
h1: Reefing: when and how to shorten sail
lead: The right amount of sail keeps a yacht fast, upright and easy to steer. Here is when to reef, and how to do it with slab reefing, in-mast furling and a roller genoa.
description: When and how to reef a sailing yacht: signs it is time, slab reefing step by step, in-mast furling mains, rolling in the genoa, sail balance and shaking out.
summary: Reef when you first think of it, and plan for the gusts, not the average wind.
For a slab reef, ease the halyard to the mark before you winch in the reefing line.
Roll in-mast mains and genoas under gentle tension, and never force a stiff furler.
Reef the main first to cure weather helm, then reduce the genoa to keep the balance.
